sect.title: Space between blocks
sect.p: The space after one block and the space before the next one are not added: the larger of the two is left between them, as DSSSL has it.
This paragraph asks for eighteen points before it and twelve after it, more than its neighbours ask, so its own spaces win on both sides.
Back to the ordinary space of four points after a paragraph, which is less than the twelve the paragraph above asks.

sect.title: Space that is not conditional
sect.p: This section begins on a new page, and its title asks for space before it that is not conditional: unlike the space of the other titles, it stays at the top of the page.
A fixed space before a paragraph and a conditional one after the paragraph before it: the larger of the two is left, whichever kind it is.

sect.title: Conditional space at the top
sect.p: This section also begins on a new page, and its title asks for conditional space before it, which is dropped at the top of the page: the title stands at the top margin.
